Messages.Author: Braddock
Messages.Body:

Messages.Author: LSJ
Messages.Body:
Braddock wrote:
>
> I have a question concerning the Rutor's Hand card.
> Superior version says that aggravated damage can be prevented.
> Since Tremere are not very adept in preventing damage, can it be prevented
> by following cards:
> Flak Jacket ?
> Leather Jacket ?
> Guardian Angel ?

No, since those cards are only usable in combat (as all damage prevention
cards are supposed to be).

Rutor's Hand has errata explaining how the damage can be prevented:

Rutor's Hand [DS] - Action (tha) (1)
* A vampire cannot have more than one Rutor's Hand. [RTR 23-JUN-1998]
* To prevent the damage from Rutor's Hand (superior version), you must
burn three blood (in addition to the cost of the action). This is
errata. (No other methods of preventing the damage can be used.)
[RTR 23-JUN-1998]

> Can Merill Molitor turn this 1 aggravated damage to normal ?

No, since his special ability is only usable in combat.

Messages.Author: James Coupe
Messages.Body:
On Sat, 29 Apr 2000, GP41 wrote:
> That is alright. But why are you saying "This is errata", right after?
> It is confusing when i am translating this and understand the rules.

It is to make it clear that this is errata.

In some cases, a ruling or a clarification will be issued where the
situation is ambiguous. That is not the case here. Damage can be
prevented, but how, under normal circumstances? So this isn't a ruling or
a card interpretation - it's making it extra, extra explicit that it's
errata.

>
> For me, it seems that the vampire burns 3 bloods to prevent the
> dammage. And right after that, you can't, cause this is errata.

Why does telling you that something is errata mean you can't do it? All
it does is tell you that it is errata.

Messages.Author: Derek Ray
Messages.Body:
On Mon, 01 May 2000 15:12:18 GMT, tetragr...@my-deja.com wrote:

>Again, do we have to keep this change?
>I think that the blood Tears of Keprhan makes it (the change on Rutor's
>Hand) obsolete and unnecessary.

Unfortunately, Blood Tears of Kephran is a card found in a
low-availability set (Ancient Hearts). Blood Tears is equipment,
meaning that a SEPARATE action must be taken to equip Blood Tears
before being able to equip Rutor's Hand. That's two +1 stealth
actions being taken by a clan that does not have easy access to any
sort of stealth, BEFORE ever getting a useful card.

This is too slow. The Tremere have enough problems as it is, and
Rutor's Hand helps to fix one of those problems admirably. Four blood
for a vampire with a built-in Freak Drive every turn is quite
appropriate - or you can play it at inferior, and have someone else
handy to fish the vampire back out of torpor. (Another action, but
this way Blythe can get a Hand.)

The errata was issued -after- Blood Tears of Kephran was printed, so
the errata takes Blood Tears' existence into account.

-- Derek
